title: x cos x and its antiderivative
caption: Integration by parts gives ∫x cos x dx = x sin x + cos x + c. The dashed curve x cos x is the slope of the solid curve at every point: where x cos x is zero, F has a turning point.
alt: The curve F(x) = x sin x + cos x and, dashed, its gradient x cos x, which crosses zero where F turns.
description: Take u = x and dv/dx = cos x, so v = sin x.
∫x cos x dx = x sin x − ∫sin x dx.
= x sin x + cos x + c.
Differentiating x sin x + cos x gives x cos x back.
